mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) as amount, count(*) as payCount, ifnull(sum(case when update_time >= #{today} then total_amount else 0 end), 0) as todayAmount, ifnull(sum(case when update_time >= #{today} then 1 else 0 end), 0) as todayCount from order_pay where pay_status = 1
select date_format(update_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as d, sum(total_amount) as amount, count(*) as cnt from order_pay where pay_status = 1 and update_time >= #{start} group by d order by d
select ifnull(cat_name, '未分类') as name, count(*) as value from book where status = 1 group by cat_name order by value desc
select book_name as bookName, author_name as authorName, visit_count as visits from book where status = 1 order by visit_count desc limit #{limit}

select case pay_channel when 1 then '支付宝' when 2 then '微信' else '其他' end as name, count(*) as value, sum(total_amount) as amount from order_pay where pay_status = 1 group by pay_channel order by value desc
